sections.theory:
7.2.5 Procedure for testing hypothesis about (μ₁ − μ₂) when σ₁² = σ₂² = σ² but unknown [small samples]

When population variances are unknown and samples are of small size then the following assumption are made to use a two-sample t-test.

(i) The sampled populations are normal.

(ii) \sigma_1^2 and \sigma_2^2 are assumed to be equal but unknown

(iii) The samples are drawn randomly.

Procedure for testing H_0 is given below:

i.\ (a)\quad H_0:\mu_1-\mu_2=0\ \text{versus}\ H_1:\mu_1-\mu_2\neq 0

(b)\quad H_0:\mu_1-\mu_2\ge 0\ \text{versus}\ H_1:\mu_1-\mu_2<0

(c)\quad H_0:\mu_1-\mu_2\le 0\ \text{versus}\ H_1:\mu_1-\mu_2>0

ii. Choose α = 0.01 or 0.05 etc.

iii. Test statistic to be used in this case is

t=\frac{(\overline{X}_1-\overline{X}_2)-(\mu_1-\mu_2)}{s_p\sqrt{\frac{1}{n_1}+\frac{1}{n_2}}}, Which has t-distribution with \nu=n_1+n_2-2 d.f.

iv. Computation of t-statistic value.

v. Critical region:

For case (a) Reject H_0 if t_c\le -t_{\alpha/2,\nu} or t\ge t_{\alpha/2,\nu}

For case (b) Reject H_0 if t_c\le -t_{\alpha,\nu}

For case (c) Reject H_0 if t_c\ge t_{\alpha,\nu}

vi. Conclusion.

Example 7.9

An examination was given to two classes of 8 and 10 students respectively. In the first class mean grade was 95 with a standard deviation of 6.8556, while in the second class, the mean grade was 97 with a standard deviation of 5.4772. It is assumed that the two classes of students are normally distributed having identical variances. Is there a significance difference between the mean grades? Test at α = 0.01.

Solution:

i. H_0:\mu_1=\mu_2 versus H_1:\mu_1\neq\mu_2

ii. α = 0.01

iii. Test statistic:

t=\frac{(\overline{X}_1-\overline{X}_2)-(\mu_1-\mu_2)}{s_p\sqrt{\frac{1}{n_1}+\frac{1}{n_2}}}، جس کی t-تقسیم \nu=n_1+n_2-2 درجاتِ آزادی کے ساتھ ہے۔

iv. t-شماریے کی قیمت کا حساب۔

v. فیصلہ کن علاقہ:

صورت (a) کے لیے H_0 کو رد کریں اگر t_c\le -t_{\alpha/2,\nu} یا t\ge t_{\alpha/2,\nu}

صورت (b) کے لیے H_0 کو رد کریں اگر t_c\le -t_{\alpha,\nu}

صورت (c) کے لیے H_0 کو رد کریں اگر t_c\ge t_{\alpha,\nu}

vi. نتیجہ۔

مثال 7.9

بالترتیب 8 اور 10 طلبہ کی دو جماعتوں کا امتحان لیا گیا۔ پہلی جماعت میں اوسط گریڈ 95 اور معیاری انحراف 6.8556 تھا، جبکہ دوسری جماعت میں اوسط گریڈ 97 اور معیاری انحراف 5.4772 تھا۔ فرض کیا جاتا ہے کہ طلبہ کی دونوں جماعتیں یکساں تغیرات کے ساتھ نارمل تقسیم شدہ ہیں۔ کیا اوسط گریڈوں کے درمیان معنی خیز فرق ہے؟ α = 0.01 پر جانچ کریں۔

حل:

i. H_0:\mu_1=\mu_2 بمقابلہ H_1:\mu_1\neq\mu_2

ii. α = 0.01

iii. جانچ کا شماریہ:

7.2.5 Procedure for testing hypothesis about (μ₁ − μ₂) when σ₁² = σ₂² = σ² but unknown [small samples]

When population variances are unknown and samples are of small size then the following assumption are made to use a two-sample t-test.

(i) The sampled populations are normal.

(ii) \sigma_1^2 and \sigma_2^2 are assumed to be equal but unknown

(iii) The samples are drawn randomly.

Procedure for testing H_0 is given below:

i.\ (a)\quad H_0:\mu_1-\mu_2=0\ ext{versus}\ H_1:\mu_1-\mu_2 eq 0

(b)\quad H_0:\mu_1-\mu_2\ge 0\ ext{versus}\ H_1:\mu_1-\mu_2<0

(c)\quad H_0:\mu_1-\mu_2\le 0\ ext{versus}\ H_1:\mu_1-\mu_2>0

ii. Choose α = 0.01 or 0.05 etc.

iii. Test statistic to be used in this case is

t= rac{(\overline{X}_1-\overline{X}_2)-(\mu_1-\mu_2)}{s_p\sqrt{ rac{1}{n_1}+ rac{1}{n_2}}}, Which has t-distribution with u=n_1+n_2-2 d.f.

iv. Computation of t-statistic value.

v. Critical region:

For case (a) Reject H_0 if t_c\le -t_{\alpha/2, u} or t\ge t_{\alpha/2, u}

For case (b) Reject H_0 if t_c\le -t_{\alpha, u}

For case (c) Reject H_0 if t_c\ge t_{\alpha, u}

vi. Conclusion.

Example 7.9

An examination was given to two classes of 8 and 10 students respectively. In the first class mean grade was 95 with a standard deviation of 6.8556, while in the second class, the mean grade was 97 with a standard deviation of 5.4772. It is assumed that the two classes of students are normally distributed having identical variances. Is there a significance difference between the mean grades? Test at α = 0.01.

Solution:

i. H_0:\mu_1=\mu_2 versus H_1:\mu_1 eq\mu_2

ii. α = 0.01
